base_object_map.description: Audited cocycle descriptor quotient on the shell-stable class.

extended_object_map.description: Packaged fixed-point strata induced by the completion endomap plus forcing structure.

definability_criterion: T1 is definable from T0 on the audited shell iff the packaged-object map factors through the T0 object map via a deterministic map.

factorization_test.note: Non-factorization holds on the audited shell because one T0 object class maps to multiple persistent T1 strata.

saturation_role: Saturation marks the point where a fixed completion rule stops producing strict growth inside T0 and therefore activates the forcing step.
forcing_role: Material P4<-P5 forcing produces persistent new packaged-object strata after saturation.
notes: The canonical object is the hybrid object itself, not the cocycle alone or the completion endomap alone.
Intrinsic extension is closed by non-factorization of the T1 object map through the T0 object map on the audited shell.
The next consequence theorem should use this canonical hybrid object directly.
